description: Ministry of Justice - The Justices of Peace Regulation No. 1 of 2016 (every Grama Niladhari to be a J.P.)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Justice under the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978, specifically establishing that Grama Niladharis in permanent service shall be Justices of the Peace. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
